offers_products.reason: Manufactures chlorine, caustic soda, epoxy materials and Winchester small caliber ammunition.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured and distributed chemicals and ammunition; no main service offering described.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Winchester ammunition is sold through retailers to shooters, hunters and sport consumers, though a smaller part than chemicals.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Chemicals are sold to industrial manufacturers, water treatment firms and distributors; ammunition goes to retailers and government.

recurring_revenue.reason: Chemical customers reorder chlorine, caustic soda and epoxy continually as production inputs, mostly repeat supply.

cyclical_demand.reason: Chlor alkali and epoxy demand tracks construction and industrial activity; customers cut orders in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Chemicals like chlorine, caustic soda and epoxy, plus ammunition, are bought frequently in repeat orders, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured chemicals and ammunition, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Chemicals sold mainly to large industrial producers and water treaters; ammunition through distributors and retailers, plus government and law enforcement.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates many chlor alkali, epoxy and ammunition plants; heavy manufacturing needing ongoing capital investment.

notes: Larger part is chemicals (chlor alkali, epoxy); Winchester ammunition also sells to consumers via retailers.
